history.content: i dont really know why im here. nothing feels wrong exactly. just kind of bored i guess
Hey, that makes sense — it sounds more like bored than “something is wrong.” Does it feel more flat, restless, or just kind of empty?
empty maybe. i dunno. like i should care about stuff and i just dont. been like this a few weeks
Empty feels closer than bored here, and the “I should care” part gives it a little pressure too. Has anything been happening around the time this started, or did it just sort of arrive?
i guess it lines up with the debt thing. found out a few weeks ago i owe way more than i thought. like 19k on cards i didnt really track
That sounds like the emptiness may be tied to a pretty hard hit of stress and disappointment. Does it feel more shut down, or more like you’re carrying a heavy, ongoing pressure?
no thats the weird part. its not stress. i feel like i SHOULD be panicking but i just feel nothing. like im reading about someone elses debt
That sounds very blank, almost detached — like it’s happening at a distance, not inside you. Does it feel more numb, or more unreal?
numb. i open the banking app and just stare at the number and close it. havent even told my partner. we share rent and i just cant make the words happen
Numb fits, and the staring/closing sounds like going quiet around it. I’m wondering if the words feel stuck, or if it’s more that the whole thing goes far away when you open the app?
the whole thing goes far away. like if i dont feel it then its not really happening. but its happening. the minimum payments are real
That sounds like it goes far away and then comes back as the minimum payments being real. We can leave it there, or stay with what that “not really happening” feeling is like for you—either is fine.
can stay a sec. the not feeling it is almost easier honestly. if i let myself actually feel it id have to do something. like call the cards. tell her. i just go flat instead
That makes sense — the flatness seems to protect you from the part that would demand action. I’m wondering if this feels like avoidance, or more like a kind of shutdown?
probably both. starts as avoiding then i just go offline in my head. anyway maybe ill open the app again tomorrow and actually look. or tell her. we'll see
That sounds like both: avoiding first, then going offline in your head. You can leave it here for now, or if you want, we can stay with what “offline” is like for you.
nah ill leave it here. helped to say it out loud i guess. thanks. gonna go
Got it — we can leave it right here. I’m glad you said it out loud, and I’ll be here if you want to pick it up again later.
